shortDescription: Boot system using specific media through HP iLO interface

options.name: force
options.description: Whether to force a reboot (even when the system is already booted). As a safeguard, without force, M(community.general.hpilo_boot) refuses to reboot a server that is already running.

options.name: host
options.description: The HP iLO hostname/address that is linked to the physical system.

options.name: idempotent_boot_once
options.description: This option makes O(state=boot_once) succeed instead of failing when the server is already powered on.

options.name: image
options.description: The URL of a cdrom, floppy or usb boot media image in the form V(protocol://username:password@hostname:port/filename). V(protocol) is either V(http) or V(https). V(username:password) is optional. V(port) is optional.

options.name: login
options.description: The login name to authenticate to the HP iLO interface.

options.name: media
options.description: The boot media to boot the system from.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to authenticate to the HP iLO interface.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the boot media. V(no_boot): Do not boot from the device. V(boot_once): Boot from the device once and then notthereafter. V(boot_always): Boot from the device each time the server is rebooted. V(connect): Connect the virtual media device and set to boot_always. V(disconnect): Disconnects the virtual media device and set to no_boot. V(poweroff): Power off the server.
